probe: Which tree does the published GitHub Pages site actually serve?
method: HTTP GET of pages that exist in only one tree, plus the Pages API settings

results.content: v2 dashboard, title 'Dashboard · NBA2 Lines Lab v2', nav includes Decision queue and Live verification
v2 artefact (as_of, calibration.margin_sd 12.75, 30 teams with reliability/luck_z)

results.note: this file exists in the repository at pages/session-audit.html (v1 tree)

conclusion: Exactly ONE tree is served: the site/ artefact published by .github/workflows/pages.yml. The Pages API's build_type=legacy + source main/ is stale metadata that does not describe what is served - proved by the 404s above. The v1 tree (root index.html, pages/**, data/site.json) is NOT reachable to any reader, yet it is still generated, linted and parity-checked by ci.yml on every push, and still contains claims that were true only before the 11/13 finals.
corrected_claim: An earlier draft of this session's own finding (F-027) said two trees both publish a dashboard. That was wrong and is corrected here: one tree publishes, and the other is unreachable maintenance debt.
